name: Sentinel: Autonomous Multi-Agent Reasoning & RAG Engine

nodes.name: Receive Question (Webhook)
nodes.notes: Receives the user's complex question via webhook.

nodes.name: Split Question into Parts
nodes.notes: Breaks down complex user questions into smaller sub-questions.

nodes.name: Route to Domain Expert
nodes.notes: Routes each sub-question to the appropriate domain expert based on metadata.

messageValues.content:
You are a domain expert. Answer the following sub-question clearly and concisely:

{{$json["subQuestion"]}}

nodes.name: Domain Expert Agent
nodes.notes: Domain experts generate answers based on assigned sub-questions.

nodes.name: Supervisor Agent
nodes.notes: Supervisor Agent compiles, verifies, and finalizes the structured answer.

nodes.name: Deliver Final Answer
nodes.notes: Sends the final structured answer back to the user.
